[[File:Thruster_lubircant.png|thumb|300px|Thruster lubricant]]
'''Thruster lubricant''' was a type of fluid that was utilized in the maintenance of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engines. The substance bore a distinctive smell and was notoriously difficult to remove from a being's hands.
